clock_scope: Three full APIs per fresh process: first plus two warm. API and normal output save included; import/interpreter/hashes/comparison separate. Shared-device ABBA observations do not establish stable speed equivalence.

gate.gpu_speed_claim: Actual ratios are reported by case and call type; static equivalence and successful runs alone do not establish a performance conclusion.

privacy: Aggregate clocks, full-output metrics, resource peaks, shapes and SHA only; no individual images, identifiers, process IDs or raw server paths.
shared_GPU_load_scope: This frozen Task01 controller records each owned process-tree memory sample; it does not log utilization at every call. Shared-device timing interference remains possible.

timings.scope: Full API plus normal output save; identical ABBA workers and shared-device observations. Interpreter/import/hash/evidence/comparison excluded.
